finding.text: Ask 4, "fix the broken web voice dictation page": the diff does not touch the Dictate page's code and the task has no shot of it. Its inbox note is marked `done` on the strength of a fake-mic run that is not in the task folder. Add the proof (a shot or a log of that run), or mark the note `partial`.
Ask 2, real-time refinement, is only partly done. The task says so honestly in `doc/redesign.md` and in the inbox lines: a one-sentence utterance still waits about 8 s for its live outline.
The new watch link is a bare "↗" (page 8). Only its tooltip says "Watch it on the session page", and it sits alone in a wide gap at 1920 (shots/…/1920.png, top band).
With no words yet, "1 · Said" is a heading over nothing. "Cleaned" says "Waiting for words." but Said has no placeholder of its own (page 9; shots/…/400.png, band 2).
`Prompt.css` adds `padding-inline: .6em` to the bled demo. That is a constant, not the spacing clamp (spacing 37), even though bleed with inner padding is otherwise right (spacing 40).

`mode-btn` wraps to 1.7 lines at 1200, 1920 and 3440 but not at 400, and `chatbox-compose-more` wraps to 2.4 lines at every width (layout.json wraps). Both are older shared-composer and chrome defects, not new ones from this change.
The Refine page's own screenshots show only the empty state, so the change itself (sentences piling up) is not visible here. The proof lives only in `test/composer-flow.mjs`.

At 3440 the `bleed` demo stretches the composer's text box about 1800 px wide, with Send alone at the far right edge, a long way from the mic (layout 3, 9; spacing 40). The bleed should paint the ground only; the box and its controls should stay at a readable width — shots/…Refine/3440.png, toolbar band.

Every page shot shows the empty state, so none of them shows asks 1 and 3: sentences adding up in the Cleaned list, and a sentence leaving the box while the next is heard. The only evidence is the builder's own `test/composer-flow.mjs` run. Add one shot with two or more sent sentences (Requirements 1, 3).

The "1 · Said" stage shows nothing under its title at 400 and 3440, although the diff adds "Nothing said yet." for an empty `raw` (Prompt.js). Either the empty case takes another path or the text is hidden — shots/…Refine/400.png, stage band.
"Watch live ↗" draws as a bare underlined arrow beside the Model picker, with no words. It is not self-evident (page 8) — shots/…Refine/400.png and 3440.png, toolbar row.

dictate-page-400-fake-mic.png: the sentence was sent as a bubble, but the box below still holds "And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what … ask what you can". This is most likely the fake mic replaying its looping wav. Still, it is the same "sent sentence repeated" symptom that RefineDemo.transcript() fixed only on the Refine page, so it should be checked before ask 4 is called done.
`padding-inline: clamp(.4em, 1vw, .9em)` is a new constant clamp, not the spacing tokens (`--pad`/`--gap`) (spacing 37) — Prompt.css.
The page h1 still sits above the toolbar, and the stage titles are still numbered. The redesign doc says so honestly (step 3 not built).
